$comment: The coverage lane's shard plan. Two consumers read this file: the
matrix from `shards`, and scripts/check-coverage-scope.py asserts that
every workspace member in Cargo.toml appears in exactly one of `shards`
or `excluded`. Adding a crate to the workspace therefore fails the guard
until someone decides, in this file, whether its lines are measured.
The reducer instruments the whole workspace, so a member that is in
neither list still lands in the denominator at 0% and quietly lowers the
Shards are balanced by test count, not by wall clock; rebalance when a
shard starts to bound the lane.

excluded.reason: Excluded from the instrumented build too (`cargo test --no-run --workspace --exclude nimbus-runtime` in the reducer), so its lines are not in the denominator either. Building V8 under LLVM instrumentation does not fit the lane's budget. Its suite runs in the rust-runtime-tests and harness-runtime jobs in ci.yml.
Generated dependency-unification crate. It carries no code to cover.
